name: Dimension Computer Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1982 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Dimension Computer Technology Co., Ltd. supplies a wide array of software and hardware systems to clients both in Taiwan and worldwide. The company provides a diverse range of services, including expert consultation, educational training programs, and IT staffing. They also manage hardware integration, planning, and installation, in addition to offering repair services, software distribution, and technical support. Their specialized solutions encompass virtualization technologies, Lotus Notes expertise, and strategies for system coexistence and migration.
